rationale: The agent appeared to update the shipping address on the wrong order (#W8268610) when the user requested the address change for #W2702727. There is no evidence of user authentication, no confirmation before performing order-changing actions, and no retrieval or explanation of the status differences between the two orders. The conditional cancellation (only if the older order can’t be guaranteed within 5 days) was not handled: no guarantee assessment, no confirmation, and no refund total provided. The agent also failed to confirm the total price of the remaining order after the address change. These issues violate the policy requirements and the user’s requests were not completed correctly.
